name: mnemonic
description: The mnemonic memory MCP server, with its embedding key read from Vault at start.

interface.shortDescription: Long-lived memory as markdown notes in git.
interface.longDescription: Runs the mnemonic memory MCP server under envconsul, which reads the workspace's Xolotl embedding key from Vault and gives it to the server alone. Requires envconsul and /etc/mnemonic/config.hcl from workspace-ansible.
